notes.title: EA Update #2 - New weapons, Arcade improvements & Connection fix
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33813869/0221686a150385a9e1fff2e5eb55b8de454876f4.png[/img]

[b]Patch Notes[/b]

- Added AUG smg ( available in gun game and as unlockable )

- Fixed connection issues

- Added NAT-type button in Create Server menu(shows if your connection is open for P2P online servers)

- Added teleport option for Arcades - accessible thrue Arcade Mode manager(TAB for on screen user interface).

- Bot autokick for arcades when new player joins.

- Edperimental tracker support for VR toy guns

- Added button for Height Detection In-game. Press menu button to access in-game menu.

- Changed  cooldown for spawn points to avoid spawning players on top of each other.

- Weapon class choice after death for Arcade Mode.

- Sniper scopes fix for more visible scopes.

- Unlimited ammo(Magazines) for Arcade Mode.

- ParticleFX fixes for a few guns.

- Removed Railway map, because it  was too big and boring.

- config.ini variable randomizerClassOverride

- serverRoundTimeLimitDropDown UI fix

- server time limit UI input value load fix

-server region dropdown enabled in server browser

-overal polish and minor fixes.


Join the discord: discord.gg/a6ZzxSa 

Thank you for all the feedback and  support! ːsteamhappyː


If you are an arcade owner, please contact us directly for any requests. We are working with all major treadmills to support soon!

notes.title: Update on the future developments(Co-op zombie mode)!
notes.content:
Hello,

We have decided to work on CO-OP zombie mode next! ːsteamhappyː 
The new game mode development is already in progress. 
The excact time frame will be announced. If you have any suggestions for the co-op mode, please let us know below in the comments section! 


Addressing the question about PC(Mouse & keyboard) support: 

Virtual Army has experimental support for regular PC players. The game starts in mouse & keyboard mode only when no VR headset is attached to the computer.
We have not included the mouse support in the list of supported input devices on Steam, because as of now it is in the testing phase and balance issues might arise in an online match against VR players. 


Thank you!
- Haptic Pulse

tags.feature: The new game mode development is already in progress.

notes.title: Release date pushed back for extra polish, Beta-Demo updated with new features!
notes.content:
Hello,

Big thanks to everyone contacting us, asking questions and beta testing, we couldnt do it without you guys on Discord and social media!

We have descided to push back the release date for extra polish and testing.

We have fixed over 50+ things since the demo and added some new features:
[list]

[*]Aiming Down Sights(less recoil, less spread, slower movement, steadier hand/aiming)

[*]Backflip ragdoll effects on headshot

[*]Recoil & animation improvements

[*]Regular sniper scopes with better zoom, crosshair removed for snipers 

[*]Virtualizer treadmill support

[*]Manual reload improvements, faster auto-reloads & auto-reload when out of bullets in the clip

[*]Controls tips/tutorial  in-game-menu

[*]Hand IK more realistic positioning

[*] Weapon recoil, spread and accuracy balancing for one handed mode, hip fire and ADS.

[*]Death audio filthers

[*]Much more to list here, check out the beta-demo
[/list]

notes.title: NEW Map Update - Cargo 29/11/2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33813869/74117109521c1c5107194a81eeedc51822401c26.png[/img]

Cargo is the 10th map for Virtual Army. 
It is one of the smallest and darkest maps in the game - great for close combat action with shotguns, assault rifles and Smg-s!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33813869/2dac2fbfa984a5ca0cd18e9747f5acc5723699f0.png[/img]

Perfect setting for the upcoming zombie mode ːsteamhappyː

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33813869/cde3e470a92de253d6ccdd25f5138ab2732eaecd.png[/img]

There are boxes, ladders & wooden planks to get on top of pretty much every container, so watch out - people might jump on you from the sky.

tags.feature: Cargo is the 10th map for Virtual Army.
